source: https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/text/structured-outputs, read 2026-10-03. Facts transcribed as lists; no live call.
scope: Structured outputs; tool parameter schemas follow the same rules (the strict flag is implicitly always true).
dialect: Schemas authored against Draft 2020-12 work best; Draft-07 is also accepted.

reinterpreted.allOf: single subschema only; multiple subschemas are best-effort

additionalProperties: defaults to false and must be set to true explicitly
nullable: type array with 'null', or an anyOf variant that includes null

constraintLimits.aboveTheLimit: accepted, conformance relies on model behavior

pattern.supported: a practical subset of ECMAScript regular expressions

bestEffortNotEnforced: allOf with more than one subschema
format values not listed as enforced
rejectedWith400: enum or anyOf with zero variants
properties with a schema of true or false
